follow-up time: Until delivery for most participants, some lost to follow up
cohort: 35 pregnant women diagnosed with dengue fever admitted to Vydehi Institute of Medical Sciences and Research Centre
finding: Early detection and appropriate management of dengue fever during pregnancy can improve both maternal and fetal outcomes.
mod_finding: Out of 25 deliveries, 13 (52%) were full term normal delivery (FTND) and 12 (48%) were lower segment cesarean section (LSCS).
